roomSummary: A modern open-plan kitchen and hallway area featuring clean white walls, tiled kitchen flooring, and light timber floorboards along the circulation zone.
camera: The camera stands in the open circulation area looking toward the kitchen cabinets and rear exterior door.

landmarks.description: Glass balustrade of the staircase on the far left
Dark grey exterior door at the rear left
Full-height window next to the rear exterior door
Black conical pendant light hanging above the peninsula
Kitchen peninsula with white countertop, sink, and dishwasher
Timber-look upper cabinets above the main kitchen counter
Built-in oven and ceramic cooktop on the back bench

walls.name: Rear exterior wall
walls.description: Wall at the back containing the exterior door and window

walls.name: Kitchen backsplash wall
walls.description: Tiled wall behind the cooktop and below the upper cabinetry

zones.name: Kitchen zone
zones.description: Tiled work area containing the peninsula, oven, and cabinetry

zones.name: Circulation corridor
zones.description: Timber floor connecting the stairs, kitchen, and rear exit

diningSpace.reason: The visible floor is a primary circulation corridor linking the stairs and exterior door; placing a dining table would obstruct essential walkways.

avoid: Do not place furniture on the timber floor that obstructs the walkway between the stairs and the rear door.
Do not add bar stools to the peninsula as it lacks a seating overhang.
Do not block access to the dishwasher or kitchen sink.
keepUntouched: Glass stair balustrade on the left
Pendant light fixture above the kitchen peninsula
Exterior door and window at the rear
All kitchen cabinetry, appliances, and countertops
